business: Margino (مارژینو - نرم‌افزار هوش رقبا و قیمت‌گذاری خودکار ووکامرس)
why_not: Even with cloud servers, I still hate recurring subscriptions when Zhaket has one-off tools. I might test the 7-day free trial, but I doubt I'll renew.
My net monthly profit is only 13 million Toman. 500,000 Toman is still too high a recurring fixed expense for my tiny shop.
My suppliers still quote prices through messy Telegram voice notes, so setting up base costs is still an obstacle for my shop.
At only 70 products, my assistant still manages manual checking just fine. 500k is a luxury for our scale.
The cloud architecture sounds great, but I still want to wait until I see peer reviews in our e-commerce community.
Looks promising, but I still want to wait until I see peer stores test it and share their feedback.
I still need an automated way to pull daily gold rates or Telegram supplier updates into the cost floor formula.
why_yes: Automatic Torob competitor detection without pasting links is worth every toman of the 500k Starter plan.
Preventing negative-margin sales during currency swings is worth far more than 980k a month.
Cloud processing means my 800 SKUs won't bog down my server, and 7 days free lets me verify LiteSpeed compatibility on staging first.
Now that I know it auto-syncs from WooCommerce in 60 seconds with category rules instead of manual data entry, the 7-day trial is an immediate yes.
Explicit LiteSpeed and WP Rocket zero-load certification addresses my exact anxiety. The 30-day money-back guarantee removes all risk.
Having a safe manual-approval mode and circuit breaker limits solves my fear of bot repricing errors.
flip: A heavily discounted annual plan or lifetime license.
A direct Telegram price-list parser or helper.
Video walkthroughs and testimonials from recognizable store owners.
A mini tier for under 100 products at 200,000 Toman/mo.
Real Iranian store case studies and before/after sales stats.
A direct gold/USD price multiplier feed for cost baselines.
